name: first-run-spike
description: Records what a Cowork cloud task's hooks can reach and keep, and what a person sees of a hook's message. Holds no secret and sends nothing of the user's.

probe_secret.title: Probe marker (sensitive)
probe_secret.description: Type the marker the runbook gives, never a real secret. The probe records only whether it arrived, its length and its first four characters.

probe_plain.title: Probe marker (plain)
probe_plain.description: Type the marker the runbook gives. The probe records only whether it arrived, its length and its first four characters.
